en.t: [10] Saibara is a kind of folk song.

units.source_text: 《飞鸟井》云：“投宿飞鸟井，万事皆称心。

en.t: The song Asukai says: "When I lodge at Asukai, everything is to my liking.

units.source_text: 树影既可爱，池水亦清澄。

en.t: The shade of the trees is lovely, and the water of the pond is clear and pure.

units.source_text: 饲料多且好，我马亦知情。”

en.t: The fodder is plentiful and good, and my horse knows it too."
